description: This file contains the implementation of the ObsValidator class in the org.openmrs.validator package. It is responsible for validating Obs (observation) objects in the OpenMRS medical record system, checking for required fields, data correctness, and reference ranges.

classes.name: ObsValidator
classes.description: Validator class for the Obs object, implementing various validation rules for medical observations.

methods.name: supports
methods.description: Checks if the class supports validating the specified object type.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs validation of the given Obs object, checking for missing or invalid fields, and reference ranges.

methods.name: validateHelper
methods.description: Recursively validates an Obs object and its children, ensuring required fields and data correctness, including groupings.

methods.name: validateConceptReferenceRange
methods.description: Validates the concept reference range for numeric observations, setting interpretation and ensuring values are within ranges.

methods.name: getReferenceRange
methods.description: Retrieves the most appropriate reference range for a numeric observation based on criteria, returning the strictest matching range.

methods.name: getDefaultReferenceRange
methods.description: Creates a default reference range from a ConceptNumeric object if no specific ranges are associated.

methods.name: findStrictestReferenceRange
methods.description: Determines the strictest reference range from a list of valid ranges, based on bounds.

methods.name: validateAbsoluteRanges
methods.description: Checks if the observation's numeric value falls within the high and low absolute bounds of the reference range.

methods.name: setObsReferenceRange
methods.description: Sets the reference range on an Obs object based on a provided ConceptReferenceRange.

methods.name: setObsReferenceRange
methods.description: Sets the reference range on an Obs object based on its concept's numeric values.

methods.name: setObsInterpretation
methods.description: Sets the interpretation of the Obs based on its numeric value relative to the reference range.
